لِيَقْضِىَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْرًۭا كَانَ مَفْعُولًۭا closely joins decree and realization.

جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا marks an enacted turning point after sustained rejection.
وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ followed by settled placement strongly supports f02 and f03 together.
وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ ٱلْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ is a close all-affairs endpoint parallel.
أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ presents the divine affair as arriving and non-deferrable.
أَمَرْنَا followed by fulfilled word and destruction gives an action-to-outcome sequence.
وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُۥ فُرُطًۭا directly joins desire-following and affair-state.
كَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا gives a decided-affair form for f03.
إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا ... كُن فَيَكُونُ reinforces immediate realization.
جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا frames an enacted decree within a judgment sequence.

Taking هَوَى as an object of devotion sharpens its controlling role.
يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ ... ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ presents an ordered course for affairs.
كَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا is a near-direct f03 realization parallel.
كَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قَدَرًۭا مَّقْدُورًۭا adds a determined-affair reading.
حِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ gives a terminal contrary reading for desire.

إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا ... كُن فَيَكُونُ gives another explicit realization form.
جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَقُضِىَ بِٱلْحَقِّ joins arrival, judgment, and outcome.

Taking هَوَى as deity, with sealing and misguidance, strongly extends f01.
Rebellion against أَمْرِ رَبِّهِم is followed by a seized outcome.

Repeated following of ظن and أَهْوَاء reinforces the evidence boundary.
وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ directly supplies a same-surah f03 realization route.
وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ supplies a broad endpoint parallel.
يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ extends the enacted divine-affair reading.
